audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart gave Pantheon levels 1 through 4-5 and 2+ items, while both the content win[] and the packet levelChart say Qiyana on all seven rows.
audit.why: Two independent sources agree against the full layer, and regression-check fails a champion whose layers disagree. The content prose already carries the honest framing: respect his levels 1-3 stun all-in, but careful play denies it and Qiyana owns every stage on the scoreboard.
audit.corrected: All seven full-layer sides moved to Qiyana with whys rewritten to match; win[] untouched (already Qiyana).

audit.whatIsWrong: Content whys[] are offset one stage from their row labels: whys[2] (Level 3 row) describes the level 6 ult spike, whys[3] (Levels 4-5) describes first item, whys[4] (Level 6) describes mid-game roams, whys[5] (First item) describes two items.
audit.why: Each row's explanation must describe its own stage.
audit.corrected: whys[1]-[5] rewritten to their correct stages at matched length; spikes[] (4 entries: L6, first item, L9 roams, two items) are correct and kept.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three verified interactions were missing: Aegis Assault (E, 22s) is an interruptible channel that Qiyana's Q/R CC cancels outright and blocks only from the front; Pantheon's combo opens with Shield Vault's auto-attack reset, making the wind-up the tell; breakdown.cooldowns had no number.
audit.why: missingInteractions rules untargetable-dodges-burst, channel-interruptible, autoreset-burst-tell, plus kit cooldowns Q 11s, W 13s, E 22s, R 180s.

audit.corrected: Replaced with bodies matching their titles.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): matchup-defining — Point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Terrashape (element swap) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): 13s at rank 1 — the point-and-click all-in opener; it doubles as an auto reset, so the wind-up is your cue, not the cast. - Aegis Assault: 22s, blocks only from the front and is a channel — your Q or R cancels it outright. - His R: 180s.

edits.before: Point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: The stun opens with an auto-reset wind-up — step back on the wind-up, then punish the 13s hole.

edits.before: Grass-Q from stealth, E-ice the answer, auto, walk back into the hedge — terrain trades he experiences as ambush weather.
edits.after: Ice-slow the chase, walk him past a wall, and cash the R stun — his kit has no answer once terrain joins the fight.

edits.before: E-ing in with no element loaded and his CC banked — Qiyana without terrain prep is a dagger doing improv.
edits.after: Past your terrain the corners stop working and his stun-spear brawl starts — the chase ends where the walls do.

edits.before: As spells come online at levels 3-5, her wall-element root plus poke out-ranges Pantheon's short-range commitment, so she controls when fights happen.
edits.after: At level 2 a second spell comes online: wall-element poke plus a dash mean Pantheon's short-range commitment no longer decides when the trades happen.

edits.before: At level 6 her AoE stun-burst ultimate can delete Pantheon before his Aegis shield or grit sustain matter, a spike he has no answer to.
edits.after: By level 3 the full string is up: she pokes, dodges Shield Vault with her own dash, and his 22-second Aegis is his only way to survive a commit.

edits.before: Her first assassin item completes the Royal Privilege plus wall combo into a full one-shot, out-scaling Pantheon's item-independent early kit.
edits.after: Through levels 4-5 her poke and disengage outrange his kit; Shield Vault runs 13s at rank 1 while her dashes return faster, so she owns the timers.

edits.before: In the mid game her attunement mobility makes her roams faster and safer than Pantheon's slow telegraphed ganks, letting her snowball side lanes.
edits.after: At level 6 Supreme Display of Talent bursts him before Aegis Assault or grit sustain matter — a spike his 180-second Grand Starfall cannot answer.

edits.before: With two items her lethality lets her ignore Pantheon's point-click W stun and kill him before his cooldowns come back online.
